entities.name: Binomial Theorem
entities.definition: The Binomial Theorem provides an algebraic formula for expanding powers of binomials into sums involving combinatorial coefficients. It allows systematic generation of terms without performing repeated multiplication operations on the initial expression.

provenance.source: Precalculus 2e (2021), OpenStax. Term locator: https://openstax.org/books/precalculus-2e/pages/11-key-terms. Used as a reference; definition independently phrased.
